tasks.description: Prevent duplicate Kiki plugin instances when global and project installs coexist
reviewNotes: Runtime dedup only suppresses copies generated by the new version. A pre-dedup copy loaded alongside a new copy still runs its hooks; the new copy cannot detect or diagnose it unless both installs are refreshed (kiki install --force and kiki update <project>).
